rows.guarantee: Failover may lose writes acknowledged within the replication lag window. This includes a DEL, so the previous value can reappear if the promoted replica missed the deletion. Stale or delayed updates never bring back a key whose deletion or expiry survived failover. Reads never return invented values. Replicas converge after writes stop. During replica replacement, a still-staged target can become primary after source fencing if it has a verified current-epoch baseline within the controller's cutover lag limit. The committed transition records both incarnations, the retained prefix and the fence. If neither a ready assigned replica nor an eligible staged copy can take over, the unavailable slot takes a fenced cold reset within the controller's repair budget.
